text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Robert Lunbeck raised his earnings estimates for Renal Treatment Centers Inc following the company's report of first quarter earnings of $0.24/shr, which beat by $0.01 the investment firm's forecast.

-- Lunbeck raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $1.10/shr on sales of $325.2 million from $1.08/shr on sales of $311 million, and he increased his 1998 estimate to $1.40/shr on sales of $447.9 million versus a previous $1.36/shr on sales of $427.8 million.
-- In a statement, Lunbeck said internal growth prospects at the company have been enhanced by recent development plans.
